description: Erection of a rear dormer roof extension, following the demolition of existing; erection of a two storey rear extension to the side of the back addition at second and first floor level, over part of the ground floor rear extension; erection of a single storey side infill extension; installation of a new window to replace existing, to the rear elevation at first floor level; alterations to the existing ground floor rear extension including installation of associated rooflights and new doors to the rear elevation; Installation of a new side access door fronting Doneraile Street within the proposed side extension, following the removal of the existing garden gate. excavation of the front garden and under the footprint of the building to form front lightwells, in connection with the enlargement of the existing basement; replacement of existing first and second floor windows on the rear and side of the back addition with double glazed windows.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

-Walls to all extensions  : Second-hand London stock brick to match the existing building in terms of brick type, mortar colour and bond pattern.

-Roof to double storey side extension : Black slate tiles to match the colour, shape and size of the existing roof covering.

-Roof to ground floor and main rear rood  extensions : Dark grey GRP or asphalt roof finish.

-Windows: Painted timber sash windows to match the style, detailing and finish of the existing windows.

-Door to rear extensions : Dark grey/black metal framed Crittall-style doors.

-Door to side extension : Painted hardwood timber door.

-Rooflights and roof lanterns: Dark grey powder-coated aluminium.

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details.] Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - No part of the basement hereby approved shall be occupied or used until the front and side lightwells have been constructed in accordance with the approved plans and the approved metal grille to the[ front and side  lightwells have been fitted flush with the surrounding ground level. The metal grille  shall be permanently retained in place there after At no time shall railings or any other vertical element be constructed around the lightwell. 

To ensure a suitable residential environment for future occupiers and a satisfactory external appearance and to prevent harm to the street scene, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, [DC8] and DC11 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principles BL1, BL2 and BL3 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).

Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment (Rev A, July 2026) and Construction Method Statement (Ref: 20260130, April 2026), both prepared by Icon Architects. No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and mitigation measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development.

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 6 - The basement hereby approved shall not be converted to use as a separate dwelling and shall only be used in connection with, and ancillary to, the use of the remainder of the application property as a single dwellinghouse.

The use of the basemen accommodation as a self-contained unit, separate from the use of the remainder of the application property as a single dwellinghouse, would raise materially different planning considerations that the Council would wish to consider at that time, and to minimise flood risk to occupiers, in accordance with Policies DC1, HO4, HO5 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).  



Condition : 7 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures (excluding solar panels and air source heat pumps) shall be erected upon the roofs of the extensions hereby permitted.

It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, contrary to Policies DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 8 - No part of any roof of the ground floor side and rear and main roof rear extensions hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto the roofs.  

The use of the roofs as a terrace would increase the likelihood of harm to the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of overlooking, noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies HO11 and CC11 of the Local Plan (2018).
